items.stem: Why are GPUs widely used to accelerate deep-learning training compared with CPUs alone?

options.text: They provide massive parallelism well suited to the matrix operations in neural networks
options.rationale: Correct: GPUs excel at the highly parallel matrix/tensor math that dominates deep-learning training.

options.text: They store far more long-term data than any CPU system
options.rationale: Acceleration comes from parallel compute, not from storage capacity.

options.text: They remove the need for any networking in a cluster
options.rationale: Networking remains essential in multi-GPU and multi-node training.

options.text: They make all training finish in a fixed one second
options.rationale: No hardware guarantees a fixed training time; this is not how acceleration works.

items.explanation: Correct: GPUs excel at the highly parallel matrix/tensor math that dominates deep-learning training.

items.stem: A model trains successfully in a notebook. Why is the AI workflow not yet complete?

options.text: The model still needs deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management in operation
options.rationale: Correct: a trained model must be deployed and operated with monitoring to deliver value.

options.text: Training success means the workflow is finished
options.rationale: Training is one stage; deployment and operations follow.

options.text: Notebooks cannot train models at all
options.rationale: Notebooks can train models; the point is later stages remain.
Monitoring is central after deployment, not only before training.

items.explanation: Correct: a trained model must be deployed and operated with monitoring to deliver value.

items.stem: Which TWO factors most favour an on-premises GPU deployment over public cloud for a workload? (Select TWO)

options.text: Strict data-residency or regulatory constraints on where data may run
options.rationale: Correct: data-residency/regulatory limits often push workloads on-prem.

options.text: Sustained, highly predictable utilisation over a long period
options.rationale: Correct: steady high utilisation can make owned hardware more cost-effective than metered cloud.

options.text: Highly variable, short-lived bursts of demand
options.rationale: Bursty, short-lived demand typically favours elastic cloud capacity.

options.text: A need to avoid any capital expenditure
options.rationale: Avoiding capex favours cloud's operating-expense model, not on-prem.

items.explanation: Correct: data-residency/regulatory limits often push workloads on-prem.
